nade68e56a4a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Naxalite groups?
o: The AP extremist CPI(ML) wing dates to 1967.
People's War Group was formed in 1980.
nade68e56a4a.x: CPI (Maoist) was formed in 2004, not 1992; the other three dates are correct.

ne280c9c2adc.s:
Consider the following statements about the Revolutionary Writers' Association (Virasam):
1. Sri Sri was its founding president.
2. Kodavatiganti Kutumba Rao and Rachakonda Viswanatha Sastry were its vice-presidents.
3. Gaddar was one of its founding vice-presidents.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
ne280c9c2adc.x: Sri Sri was president and Kutumba Rao and Viswanatha Sastry were vice-presidents; Gaddar was with Art Lovers / Jana Natya Mandali, not a Virasam vice-president.

n70089d87a50.s:
Consider the following statements about the Greyhounds base at Anandapuram:
1. It secures the Left Wing Extremism corridor of the Alluri Sitharama Raju and Parvathipuram Manyam districts.
2. These districts lie in north coastal Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n70089d87a50.x: The Anandapuram base secures the LWE corridor of the ASR and Parvathipuram Manyam districts, both in north coastal Andhra Pradesh.

n9b9e4fc6d64.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about prohibition in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Total prohibition came before the ban on arrack.
n9b9e4fc6d64.x: Arrack was banned first (1 October 1993); total prohibition followed in 1995 and was lifted in 1997.

n6c6908457ac.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the campaign against Devadasi dedication in Madras?
o: Muthulakshmi Reddy campaigned against Devadasi dedication.
Ammannaraja moved an anti-dedication bill in the Madras Assembly.
Ammannaraja's bill followed Muthulakshmi Reddy's campaign.
n6c6908457ac.x: Ammannaraja's anti-dedication bill came in 1937, not 1947, after Muthulakshmi Reddy's campaign.

n1f4fa3cee88.s:
Consider the following statements about the journals Janana and Satihita Bodhini:
1. They were journals of Kandukuri Veeresalingam.
2. They promoted women's education and widow remarriage.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n1f4fa3cee88.x: Both journals were Kandukuri Veeresalingam's and promoted women's education and widow remarriage.

new.s: The Naxalbari uprising of 1967 took place in which district of West Bengal?
new.x: Naxalbari lies in the Siliguri sub-division of Darjeeling district, West Bengal.

new.s: Who led the Srikakulam Girijan struggle?
o: Tarimela Nagi Reddy and Chandra Pulla Reddy
new.x: The school teachers Vempatapu Satyam and Adibhatla Kailasam led the Srikakulam struggle; Majumdar and Sanyal led Naxalbari.

new.s: The Srikakulam Girijan struggle began under which party?
new.x: The struggle began under the CPI(M) and shifted to the CPI(ML) only in 1969.

new.s: The Srikakulam struggle was triggered by the killing of two tribal activists on 31 October 1967 at:
new.x: Koraana and Manganna were killed at Levidi on the way to a Girijan Sangham meeting.

new.s: Who founded the People's War Group in 1980?
new.x: Kondapalli Seetharamaiah founded the PWG in 1980; Charu Majumdar founded the CPI(ML) in 1969.

new.s: The CPI (Maoist) was formed in 2004 by the merger of:
new.x: CPI (Maoist) was formed in 2004 by the merger of the People's War Group and the MCC.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the CPI(ML):
1. It was founded in 1969 by Charu Majumdar.
2. Its base was West Bengal.
3. It saw the Indian state as semi-feudal and followed a Chinese-model protracted guerrilla war.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: CPI(ML) was formed in 1969 by Charu Majumdar, based in West Bengal, on a Chinese-model guerrilla line.

new.s: Virasam's first poetry collection, published in 1970, was:
new.x: Jhamjha (1970) was Virasam's first poetry collection.

new.s: Art Lovers, founded in 1970 by B. Narsinga Rao and Gaddar, was renamed Jana Natya Mandali in:
new.x: Art Lovers (1970) became Jana Natya Mandali in 1971.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: The Greyhounds were raised in 1989; 1992 is the year the PWG was banned.

new.s: Who headed the 1977 commission that inquired into Emergency 'encounter' killings of Naxalites in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The Bhargava Commission (1977) was headed by Justice Vashist Bhargava.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Bhargava Commission?
o: It was headed by Justice Vashist Bhargava.
It inquired into the implementation of land reforms.
It probed encounter killings during the Emergency (1975–77).
new.x: The Bhargava Commission probed Emergency encounter killings, not land reforms.

new.s: The surrender policy under which over 1,200 Naxalite cadres surrendered in Andhra Pradesh ran during:
new.x: Under DGP H.J. Dora, the surrender policy of 1998–2001 saw over 1,200 cadres surrender.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Greyhounds?
o: It is an elite anti-Naxal special police force.
Its training centre is at Anandapuram.
It is a dog squad of the AP Police.
new.x: The Greyhounds is a special police force, not a dog squad.

new.s: The 1919 Adi-Andhra conference at Machilipatnam was led by:
new.x: Bhagya Reddy Varma led the 1919 Machilipatnam conference; Kusuma Dharmanna led the 1936 Vizianagaram Mahasabha.

new.s: Phule's Satyashodhak Samaj, which inspired the Adi-Andhra leaders, was founded in:
new.x: Jyotirao Phule's Satyashodhak Samaj was founded in 1873.

new.s: The Karamchedu massacre of Dalits took place in:
new.x: Karamchedu was on 17 July 1985; 1991 is the year of the Chunduru massacre.

new.s: Besides Katti Padmarao, who is recognised as a founder of the AP Dalit Mahasabha?
new.x: Bojja Tarakam is also recognised as a founder of the AP Dalit Mahasabha (1985).

new.s: Who founded the Madiga Reservation Porata Samiti (Madiga Dandora)?
new.x: Manda Krishna Madiga was the founder-president of the MRPS.

new.s: The main demand of the Madiga Dandora was:
o: Inclusion of minorities in the BC list
new.x: MRPS demanded sub-categorisation of SC reservation so that Madigas get a fair share.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the MRPS:
1. It was founded on 7 July 1994.
2. It was founded at Eedumudi village in Prakasam district.
3. Its founder received the Padma Shri in 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All are correct: MRPS was founded on 7 July 1994 at Eedumudi, Prakasam; Manda Krishna Madiga got the Padma Shri in 2025.

new.s: The Mandal Commission recommended OBC reservation of:
new.x: The Mandal Commission recommended 27% reservation for OBCs.

new.s: The Mandal Commission recommendations were implemented on 7 August 1990 by the government of:
new.x: V.P. Singh's government implemented the Mandal recommendations on 7 August 1990.

new.s: The First Backward Classes Commission (Kaka Kalelkar) was set up in January 1953 under Article:
new.x: The Kaka Kalelkar Commission was set up under Article 340 in January 1953.

new.s: The Muralidhar Rao Commission on backward classes in Andhra Pradesh took charge in:
new.x: The Muralidhar Rao Commission took charge on 27 January 1982; Anantharaman (1968–70) was the first AP BC Commission.

new.s: The Bashir Bagh firing on power-tariff protesters in Hyderabad took place in:
new.x: The Bashir Bagh firing was on 28 August 2000, during the power tariff agitation.

new.s: N.G. Ranga founded the Indian Peasants' Institute in 1933 at:
new.x: N.G. Ranga set up the Indian Peasants' Institute at Nidubrolu in 1933.

new.s: The All India Kisan Sabha is a mass organisation of the:
new.x: AIKS is a mass organisation of the CPI, not the Congress.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT a method of the anti-arrack women?
new.x: Legislative elections were not a method; women closed shops and stopped auctions with broomsticks and chilli powder.

new.s: Dubagunta, where the anti-arrack movement began, is in which district?
new.x: Dubagunta village is in Nellore district, not Guntur.

new.s: In the 1930s Kallur Subbarao led anti-liquor and Swadeshi movements in:
new.x: Kallur Subbarao led the anti-liquor and Swadeshi movements in the Dattamandalas (Rayalaseema).

new.s: The anti-arrack movement of Andhra Pradesh grew out of:
new.x: The movement grew out of the Aksharajyothi adult-literacy classes.

new.s: As an outcome of the anti-arrack movement, arrack was prohibited in Andhra Pradesh from:
new.x: Arrack was prohibited in AP from 1 October 1993.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the anti-arrack movement:
1. It began in Dubagunta village of Nellore district.
2. It was led by rural women.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: it began in Dubagunta, Nellore, and was led by rural women.

new.s: Velugu (2000) was started by which Chief Minister?
new.x: Velugu was started in 2000 by CM Chandrababu Naidu and run by SERP.

new.s: DWCRA has worked in Andhra Pradesh since:
new.x: DWCRA has been in AP since 1983–84.

new.s: Velugu was later renamed:
new.x: In the mid-2000s Velugu was renamed Indira Kranthi Patham, integrating DWCRA and Velugu work.

new.s: The Stree Shakti Sanghatana, Hyderabad, was founded in:
new.x: Stree Shakti Sanghatana was founded in 1978; 1974 is the POW.

new.s: Who founded the Stree Shakti Sanghatana?
new.x: Vasantha Kannabiran and K. Lalita founded the Stree Shakti Sanghatana in 1978.

new.s: The Telugu feminist magazine Bhumika was founded in:
new.x: Bhumika, edited by Kondaveeti Satyavathi, was founded in 1993.

new.s: Who was the first woman Governor of Andhra Pradesh (1977)?
new.x: Sharda Mukherjee became the first woman Governor of AP in 1977.

new.s: Durgabai Deshmukh was the first chair of the:
new.x: Durgabai Deshmukh was the first chair of the Central Social Welfare Board (1953).

new.s: The Madras Devadasis (Prevention of Dedication) Act was passed in:
new.x: The Madras Act came in 1947; the AP Devadasis Act came in 1988.

new.s: The Dowry Prohibition Act was enacted in:
new.x: The Dowry Prohibition Act was enacted in 1961.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh gave daughters coparcenary rights in 1986; the Central amendment followed in:
new.x: AP's 1986 amendment came before the Central amendment of 2005.

new.s: Article 243T provides one-third reservation for women in:
new.x: Article 243T covers Municipalities; Article 243D(3) covers Panchayats.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about women's reservation in local bodies:
1. It came with the 73rd and 74th Amendments of 1992.
2. Article 243D(3) applies to Municipalities.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The 73rd/74th Amendments (1992) gave one-third seats; 243D(3) covers Panchayats, not Municipalities.

new.s: The 181 Women Helpline in Andhra Pradesh has run since:
new.x: The 181 Women Helpline has run since 2016.
